Pronunciation: a:rine [uh-reen]. Noun: Arine is a name of Basque origin meaning "light." Arine illuminates the possibilities with medication management to deliver comprehensive economic and health outcomes. 

Based in San Francisco, Arine is a rapidly growing healthcare technology and clinical services company with a mission to ensure individuals receive the safest and most effective treatments for their unique and evolving healthcare needs. 

Frequently, medications cause more harm than good. Incorrect drugs and doses costs the US healthcare system over $528 billion in waste, avoidable harm, and hospitalizations each year. Arine is redefining what excellent healthcare looks like by solving these issues through our software platform (SaaS). We combine cutting edge data science, machine learning, AI, and deep clinical expertise to introduce a patient-centric view to medication management, and develop and deliver personalized care plans on a massive scale for patients and their care teams.

Arine is committed to improving the lives and health of complex patients that have an outsized impact on healthcare costs and have traditionally been difficult to identify and address. These patients face numerous challenges including complicated prescribing issues across multiple medications and providers, medication challenges with many chronic diseases, and patient issues with access to care. Backed by leading healthcare investors and collaborating with top healthcare organizations and providers, we deliver recommendations and facilitate clinical interventions that lead to significant, measurable health improvements for patients and cost savings for customers. 

Why is Arine a Great Place to Work?:

Outstanding Team and Culture - Our shared mission unites and motivates us to do our best work. We have a relentless passion and commitment to the innovation required to be the market leader in medication intelligence.

Making a Proven Difference in Healthcare - We are saving patient lives, and enabling individuals to experience improved health outcomes, including significant reductions in hospitalizations and cost of care.

Market Opportunity - Arine is backed by leading healthcare investors and was founded to tackle one of the largest healthcare problems today. Non-optimized medications therapies which cost the US 275,000 lives and $528 billion annually.

Dramatic Growth - Arine is managing more than 18 million lives across prominent health plans after only 4 years in the market, and was ranked 236 on the 2024 Inc. 5000 list and was named the 5th fastest-growing company in the AI category.

The Role:

You will be joining an SLT that values a close and solutions-focused partnership with the People Team, a CEO who is thoughtful and detail-oriented, and a CFO who is your closest operational partner. You will inherit a strong team and a solid infrastructure foundation. This is not a role for someone who wants to run a steady-state People function. Arine is in an active growth phase with real cultural complexity, a workforce that spans different operating models, and an SLT that moves fast. What the organization needs now is someone who can take that foundation and grow the culture and talent strategy layer on top of it.

What You’ll be Doing / Own:

SLT Partnership 

Based on a thorough understanding of the business, work with SLT to develop People strategies that align with and support opportunities for cross-team collaboration and org efficienciesServe as the organization's change management resource, equipping SLT and function heads with frameworks and support to lead their teams through changePartner with function heads to develop their management capabilitiesOrg Design and Headcount Governance

Advise on organizational design as Arine continues to scale and add complexityOwn the headcount planning and backfill governance process in partnership with the CFOCulture and Org Health Monitoring and Reporting

Own the design and execution of organizational health monitoring, reporting on trends to leadership, and driving action plans that close identified gaps Own the ongoing pulse survey program and translate anonymous data into SLT-level recommendations with clarity and urgencyServe as a thought partner for cultural initiatives and improvements to the employee experience based on dataTalent and Recruiting

Oversee the recruiting function and ensure recruiting efforts align with expectations (e.g., market data, employee profile, recruiting strategy, seasonal hiring fluctuations) for diverse requisitions across technical and clinical roles, ensuring a holistic view of the candidate/employee lifecyclePartner with recruiting leads on offer strategy, compensation benchmarking, and leveling decisionsLead talent assessment and succession planning initiativesPartner with functional leads to define paths for employee development People Operations and Compliance

Own the full people operations foundation: HRIS (Rippling), immigration, benefits, compliance, and leave managementEnsure the team runs with precision, especially on time-sensitive legal and regulatory requirementsContinue the AI-enabled People Ops work already in flight, including workflow automation and analytics, while continuing to identify opportunities for automation and enablement across the company within accessible Rippling tools and dashboardsDevelop knowledge transfer initiatives and improve employee onboarding to decrease time to productivityTeam Leadership

Lead, develop, and advocate for the People Team, guiding team members to the best possible and timely outcomesIdentify and invest in the development paths of your directs, particularly those who are stepping into new responsibilitiesWho You Are and What You Bring:

15+ years of People leadership experience, with at least 3 years in a Head of People or VP-equivalent roleDemonstrated ability to partner effectively with C-level executives and senior leaders and influence outcomesExperience at a high-growth tech company between Series B and Series D Comfort operating in ambiguity without waiting for permission to actExperience in a healthcare, health tech, or regulated industry companyBackground supporting engineering or product organizations specificallyFamiliarity with Rippling as HRIS Exposure to AI enablement or responsible AI adoption within a People functionDemonstrated ability to lead across two distinct workforce populations: a technical org and a high-volume or operationally intensive workforce (clinical, support, call center, or similar)Travel and Other Information:

This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, with an expectation of working onsite 2-3 days per weekPerks:

Joining Arine offers you a dynamic role and the opportunity to contribute to the company's growth and shape its future. You'll have unparalleled learning and growth prospects, collaborating closely with experienced Clinicians, Engineers, Software Architects, and Digital Health Entrepreneurs.

The posted range represents the expected salary for this position and does not include any other potential components of the compensation package, benefits, and perks. Ultimately, the final pay decision will consider factors such as your experience, job level, location, and other relevant job-related criteria. The salary range for this position is: $240,000-260,000/year.

Job Requirements:

Ability to pass a background checkMust live in and be eligible to work in the United StatesInformation Security Roles and Responsibilities:

All staff at Arine are expected to be part of its Information Security Management Program and undergo periodic training on Information Security Awareness and HIPAA guidelines. Each user is responsible to maintain a secure working environment and follow all policies and procedures. Upon hire, each person is assigned and must complete trainings before access is granted for their specific role within Arine.

Check our website at https://www.arine.io. This is a unique opportunity to join a growing start-up revolutionizing the healthcare industry!

Arine is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with fairness and respect. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other legally protected status. Our hiring decisions and employment practices are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and join us in our mission.

For security purposes, official communications from Arine will only come from @arine.io email addresses or through our authorized platforms, including Rippling, TurboCheck, Jobma, and Checkr. If you receive a message claiming to be from Arine through another source, or if you have concerns about its authenticity, please contact us before sharing personal information or taking any action. We will never request payment or sensitive personal information (copy of government-issued ID, social security number, bank details, etc.) during the recruiting process.

Note to Recruitment Agencies: We appreciate your interest in finding talent for Arine, but please be advised that we do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. All resumes submitted to Arine without a prior written agreement in place will be considered property of Arine, and no fee will be paid in the event of a hire. Thank you for your understanding.

About Excel™Ranked 6X by Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing companies in America, and certified by Great Places to Work, Excel™ specializes in digital advertising and performance marketing, playing a pivotal role in connecting consumers with insurance brands, at scale. We partner with large strategic brands such as insurance carriers, brokers, and agencies, supplying them with high quality prospects looking for their services. This involves owning and operating top-rated insurance websites that we promote via paid search marketing driving the highest-intent consumers looking to acquire an insurance plan to meet their needs.

Our Vision: Acquiring great customers should be simple.  Our Mission: Helping insurance brands acquire the right customers at scale.Our Values:  E - Embrace Simplicity, X - XL Impact, C - Customer Centric, E - Extreme Ownership, L - Laser Focused.Our teamAt Excel™ we believe remote working is an important way to enable people to achieve their best work while maximizing time efficiency and personal freedom.  Our culture is based on team-based performance that is highly aligned but loosely coupled, extreme ownership, growth mindset, curiosity, personal accountability, and we flourish because of the creativity and input from our team members. As an agile and innovative company, we are always looking for our next high performer to help transform the future!

About the role

Excel™ is seeking a strategic and hands-on VP,  Head of People to lead the company's people strategy, talent management, organizational effectiveness, and HR operations. Reporting directly to the CEO, the Head of People will serve as a key member of the leadership team, responsible for aligning talent and culture initiatives with business objectives while building a high-performing, scalable organization.

This leader will oversee the full employee lifecycle, including talent acquisition, leadership development, performance management, employee engagement, total rewards, HR operations, and compliance. The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen with operational excellence and a proven ability to scale people programs in a high-growth environment.

Why This Role Matters

People are one of Excel™’s most important competitive advantages. The VP, Head of People will play a critical role in ensuring the company attracts exceptional talent, develops strong leaders, strengthens employee engagement, and builds a culture where high performers can thrive. This leader will help shape the company’s next phase of growth by aligning talent, culture, leadership, and HR operations with measurable business outcomes.

Key responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Organizational Effectiveness

Partner with the executive leadership team to develop and execute a people strategy that supports business objectives and long-term growth.Serve as a trusted advisor on organizational design, workforce planning, succession planning, and leadership effectiveness.Lead organizational change and transformation initiatives that improve performance, scalability, and employee experience.Utilize workforce analytics and business insights to drive data-informed decision-making.Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning

Lead recruiting and workforce planning strategies that attract, hire, and retain high-performing talent across the organization.Build scalable recruiting, onboarding, succession planning, and talent development programs that strengthen organizational capability and leadership readiness.Partner with business leaders to identify staffing needs, talent gaps, bench strength, and future hiring needs.Strengthen employer branding and drive continuous improvement in recruiting processes, candidate experience, employee value proposition and overall talent acquisition performance to improve hiring outcomes through data-informed decision-making.Performance Management, Culture & Accountability

Lead performance management programs that align individual, team, and company performance with business objectives.Foster a high-performance culture built on accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, measurable results, and alignment with company values.Coach leaders and managers on performance conversations, employee development, feedback, recognition, accountability, and talent management best practices.Partner with executives and leaders to identify, develop, and retain high-potential employees while strengthening leadership capability across the organization.Leadership Development & Talent Development

Design and implement leadership development programs that strengthen management capability and build organizational leadership capacity.Equip managers with the tools, skills, and coaching needed to lead high-performing teams and drive business results.Support long-term talent development, employee growth, and leadership readiness across the organization.Lead and support organizational change initiatives that enhance agility, performance, and continuous improvement.Employee Experience, Engagement & Employee Relations

Champion an employee experience that supports engagement, retention, accountability, transparency, innovation, and high performance.Lead employee engagement, recognition, reward, and retention strategies that reinforce company values and support organizational commitment.Provide leadership and guidance on employee relations matters, workplace investigations, corrective action, conflict resolution, and policy administration.Promote collaboration, continuous learning, diverse perspectives, and professional development to support innovation and organizational growth.Compensation, Benefits & Total Rewards

Lead competitive compensation, benefits, and total rewards programs that attract, retain, and motivate top talent.Partner with leadership to design and administer performance-based incentive and bonus programs aligned with business objectives and company performance.Oversee compensation planning, salary benchmarking, pay practices, benefits administration, and internal equity considerations.Evaluate and enhance benefits programs to support employee well-being while aligning with organizational goals and cost management priorities.HR Operations, Compliance & People Analytics

Ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations.Oversee HR systems, reporting, people analytics, policy administration, process improvement, and HR governance practices.Continuously improve HR programs, processes, and operational efficiencies to enhance scalability, employee experience, and organizational effectiveness.Develop scalable HR infrastructure and risk management practices that support business growth while maintaining compliance and operational excellence.Qualifications

 Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or related field; advanced degree preferred.10+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, including experience leading HR or People functions within high-growth, performance-driven organizations.  SHRM-SCP, SPHR, SHRM-CP, or PHR certification strongly preferred.Strong knowledge of employment law, employee relations, talent and performance management, compensation, benefits, HR operations, and HR best practices.Proven success developing talent acquisition, leadership development, performance management, compensation, and employee engagement strategies that support measurable business outcomes. Strong business acumen with the ability to leverage workforce analytics, financial insights, organizational data, and business metrics to influence executive decision-making.  Strong communication, relationship-building, and change management skills. Experience within digital marketing, lead generation, technology, SaaS, or professional services organizations preferred. Experience supporting remote and multi-state workforces preferred.Key Competencies

Strategic LeadershipExecutive Presence Talent DevelopmentOrganizational Effectiveness Business PartnershipSuccess Measures

Strengthen talent acquisition, leadership development, and succession planning capabilities.Improve employee engagement, retention, and organizational performance.Implement scalable people programs and processes that support continued business growth.Enhance people analytics and workforce reporting to support strategic decision-making.Ensure HR operations, compliance, and infrastructure effectively support organizational success.Reporting relationships
